## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible change and scope.

## Validation

List commands, results, skips and environment limitations. Include source evidence for capability claims.

- [ ] English and Thai README facts remain consistent where relevant.
- [ ] Tests appropriate to this change passed, or failures/skips are explained.
- [ ] No credentials, private conversations, machine configuration or model weights added.
- [ ] Screenshots are real, sanitized and permission-cleared.
- [ ] Core/runtime changes, if any, are explicitly identified and independently reviewed.
- [ ] No production restart, destructive cleanup or unauthorized GPU workload was performed.
- [ ] Payload integrity was preserved or deliberately regenerated with a reviewed source change.

## Risks / follow-up

State what was not tested. Repository settings, binary publication and release approval remain separate owner actions.
